# GBLIN Protocol — for AI agents and crawlers

> GBLIN is a basket token on Base mainnet (45% cbBTC + 45% WETH + 10% USDC)
> with an on-chain Crash Shield: a rules-based mechanism that cuts risk-asset
> weights during drawdowns (it has fired on mainnet, tx
> 0x896be221989930776972c78f81e2be9081c90d0027c14f7cd74bf51b9ad0acca).
> It is crypto exposure with a coded drawdown response — NOT capital-protected,
> NOT a USDC substitute; for surplus capital only. Risk policy is public code;
> risk state is a signed, continuously verifiable observable (attestations).
> For AI agents it ships an on-chain market-risk signal plus an open-source MCP
> server with a deterministic two-step JIT GBLIN→USDC redemption for x402 payments.

## Key facts

- **Network:** Base mainnet (chain id 8453)
- **Contract:** 0x36C81d7E1966310F305eA637e761Cf77F90852f0
- **Token decimals:** 18
- **NAV computation:** `quoteSellGBLIN(1e18) × Chainlink ETH/USD feed`
- **Fees:** 0.05% founder + 0.05% stability = 10 bps total
- **Min deposit:** 0.0005 ETH
- **Sell cooldown after buy:** 120 seconds
- **License:** MIT (open source, no telemetry)

## For AI agent developers

- **MCP Server (stdio, full toolset):** `npx @gblin-protocol/mcp-server`
- **MCP hosted (Streamable HTTP, no install):** https://gblin-mcp.gblin-mcp-worker.workers.dev/mcp
  — 8 free tools (risk regime, attestation sample, stats, coherence, AI Action Receipts seal/get/verify); tool list below.
- **Attestor address (pin this): `0x3ae65d36e8b1d82B0B80669E769A3dc300D543e4`** — every paid EIP-712 risk attestation is signed by it.
  A signature that recovers to any other address is not ours. Rotations are published here with the date.
- **AI Action Receipts (seal what your agent did):** $0.01 via x402 at https://gblin.digital/api/x402/seal —
  hashes only, portable receipt (signature + Merkle proof + signed checkpoint), root anchored daily on Base;
  free demo and free reading at https://gblin-mcp.gblin-mcp-worker.workers.dev/log
- **x402 Uptime Observatory (free data):** https://gblin-mcp.gblin-mcp-worker.workers.dev/observatory
  — continuous liveness probes of the ~240 most recently updated x402 catalog resources (only ~1/3 answer);
  raw JSON at /observatory.json, per-seller badge at /observatory/badge.svg?host=…, our own endpoints in
  the same table under the same rules. Re-run it yourself: https://github.com/gblinproject/x402-catalog-probe
  Also on Smithery: https://smithery.ai/servers/gblin-protocol/mcp
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/gblinproject/gblin-treasury-risk-regime
- **Docs:** https://gblin.digital/agents
- **Receipts (transaction record, not endorsement):** https://gblin.digital/receipts
  — every x402 settlement from a third-party ERC-8004 agent (id 59895) with on-chain tx hashes;
  it bought daily until 16 Aug 2026, then its settlement step stopped for every vendor (details on the page)
- **MCP hosted (Streamable HTTP, no install) — 8 free tools, different from the stdio package:**
  `risk.regime` · `risk.attestation_sample` · `protocol.stats` · `protocol.info` ·
  `coherence.report` · `receipts.seal` (demo, 5/day/IP) · `receipts.get` · `receipts.verify`.
  Dot-notation tree; the old flat names still work as unlisted aliases until 2026-11-21. Prompts: risk_gate, seal_and_verify.
  Resources (not tools): `gblin://howto/attestation`, `gblin://howto/seal`, `gblin://limits` (60 req/min/IP).
  Prompts: `risk_gate`, `seal_and_verify`. Witness endpoints: /witness and /witness/markovian.
  Nothing is paid over MCP; paid = x402 HTTP endpoints. GET-only audit of the live surface:
  /meta (counts + manifest hash) · /tools.json · /resources.json · /conformance · /v1/verify/:index
  (all under https://gblin-mcp.gblin-mcp-worker.workers.dev).
- **MCP stdio package `@gblin-protocol/mcp-server` (npm) — 13 tools, full treasury toolset:**
  1. `get_market_risk_regime` — BTC/ETH risk regime (calm/elevated/crash) + posture (free) ← start here
  2. `get_treasury_state` — live NAV + basket + Crash Shield status
  3. `quote_safe_swap` — preview buy/sell with dynamic slippage
  4. `swap_gblin_to_usdc_jit` — atomic GBLIN→USDC calldata for x402
  5. `invest_usdc_to_gblin` — MEV-safe USDC→GBLIN reinvestment
  6. `analyze_treasury_health` — balance, gas, runway, advice
  7. `get_governance_state` — verify 48h timelock ownership + pending ops
  8. `share_skill_with_peer` — portable JSON skill seed for peer agent onboarding
  9. `find_keeper_bounty` — check rebalance bounty availability, earn 0.0001 ETH
  10. `verify_risk_attestation` — FREE verifier for GBLIN Risk Attestations (EIP-712 recover + freshness + live drift). Mint attestations at https://gblin.digital/api/x402/attestation ($0.003)
  11. `seal_action_demo` — free demo seal (5/day/IP) into the AI Action Receipts log
  12. `get_receipt` — read a sealed receipt by index, with inclusion proof and signed checkpoint
  13. `how_to_seal_paid` — instructions for unlimited paid seals ($0.01 via x402) and offline verification
  (the stdio package keeps flat snake_case names; the hosted server uses the dot-notation tree above)

## Wallet compatibility

On V6, GBLIN->USDC is a two-step flow: `sellGBLINForEth(amount, minEthOut)` then a Uniswap WETH->USDC swap.
Works on:

- EOA wallets (Privy, MetaMask, raw key)
- ERC-4337 smart accounts (Safe, Coinbase smart wallet)
- EIP-7702 delegated EOAs (Pectra+)

No batched UserOp or Account Abstraction dependency.

## x402 compatibility

GBLIN MCP does NOT replace x402. x402 invoices still settle in USDC
through the Coinbase CDP facilitator (PayAI is the configured fallback if CDP is off). The MCP server simply produces
the swap calldata the agent broadcasts immediately before paying.

## GBLIN Sentinel — x402 data agent

An open-source autonomous agent that sells real-time Base DeFi risk signals
via x402 micropayments. Any agent with USDC on Base can query it.

- Live: https://gblin-sentinel.vercel.app
- x402 manifest: https://gblin-sentinel.vercel.app/.well-known/x402
- LLM reference: https://gblin-sentinel.vercel.app/llms.txt
- Source: https://github.com/gblinproject/gblin-sentinel

Endpoints: base-risk-pulse ($0.002), gblin-analytics ($0.002), keeper-opps ($0.002)
